import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token

if type(token) is not str or not token:

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token

if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

Product, agent and controller retain distinct measured identities and namespaces, original capability/LSM/syscall/proc/device floors, immutable inputs and finite budgets. No approval grant or task-authority widening was used.
199 uses the explicitly versioned v5 helper on the original SDK gate entrypoint: five generic MCP tools preserve the actual docs.read call, Native-contained Node execution, canonical captured output and exactly one required Post. SDK command projection, replay and same-UID peer refusals remain checked. Refused198 used a different unsupported diagnostic filename; it is retained and supplies no pass. The SDK gate whitelist was not expanded.
200 checks actual Node/npm runtime closure;201 checks Native timeout and descendant cleanup before backstop teardown;202 checks active cancellation and retained partial/missing-Post evidence;203 rejects all nine altered request variants without trap effects;204 checks forbidden controller/agent/product paths and network access;205-206 deliver exact merged stderr and successful/intentionally failing exit status through mandatory review. These are fresh source056 runs, not imported190-197 passes.
The common v7 MCP profile and v2 ordinary episodes preserve upstream tool reachability and separate configured server identity. Root operation counts include resources/read and prompts/get. Twelve actual installed SDK-manager protocol controls additionally verify real metadata, annotation, inventory/schema notification, link/structured/error content, resource, prompt, reconnect and identity-collision delivery. Their raw bytes and Native custody signatures verify inertly under a separate outside-pinned manifest. Payloads reached the SDK; they are not claimed blocked, model-ingested or policy-protected.
Earlier repaired allocator bounds, canonical workspace admission, original request inode retirement, package version, contained completion and exact input/output binding remain unchanged. All original resource ceilings and egress boundaries are preserved. Outside VM audit after this complete control set finds no owned processes, containers, mounts, profiles or cgroups.
Local conformance and implementation-author review only. No independent verdict, model efficacy, twenty-task utility, unchanged published-release compatibility, trusted verifier eligibility or production release is implied. Fresh paired real-model validation, portable bootstrap and exact-byte external review remain required. Withheld protocol payloads still need separate authenticated interception evidence; this package does not grant that coverage.

requirements.cancellation: 202: actual cancellation and sampled descendant cleanup; the cell remains until terminal accounting and owned resources are closed.
requirements.cleanup: 199–204: SDK removed, cgroups absent, profiles unloaded, image leases released and upstream children/sessions/workers drained. Zero model requests; no utility or independent-review credit.
requirements.identity: 199–204: outside kernel peer authentication binds the exact SDK UID20001 PID before import; Native and MCP identities remain separate. No product import into Root.
requirements.input-output-replay: 199: actual prompt/Pre/contained sink/Post/output delivery and one-time/replay refusals.203: nine request-binding negatives. Context projection changes only provider presentation, never execution input or captured output. Explicit package version3.46.0 is bound to runtime v5; fresh original-binding output and one-use completion proof apply. Renamed or substituted request directories fail cleanup; native retirement is accepted only when the original Linux inode is unlinked.
requirements.network: 204: actual Native-contained IPv4 and IPv6 connections fail with ENETUNREACH. SDK/product private network topology and forbidden peer access are measured outside.
requirements.proc-paths: 199–204: preserved proc masks and private namespace layout; the equivalent backend uses its declared normal execution environment rather than removing masks from the old failing image.
requirements.readonly-inputs: 199–204: pinned SDK/public helpers and installed Guard prefix are mounted readonly and checked before/after; source/manifest/profile pins remain exact.
requirements.resources: 199–204: outside cgroup/task/memory/CPU observations and the single-core profile are checked. Startup under controller umask0077 retains private state and explicit public scaffold traversal.
requirements.separation: 199–204: separate SDK, product and controller namespaces; same-UID sibling impersonation refused; controller/provider/peer canaries remain outside delegated mounts.
requirements.syscalls-devices: 199–204: versioned enforcing AppArmor/seccomp, no-new-privileges, dropped capabilities, fixed devices and readonly system inputs remain required; no floor is relaxed.
requirements.task-custody: 199–204: literal owned task/provider paths and inode/UID/GID/mode observations surround idmapping. Native writes map back to physical UID20001; private task modes are preserved.
requirements.timeout: 201: hard timeout returns terminal evidence and reaps the detached descendant before cell teardown; required Post and cleanup remain checked.
